story: Rosa opened her first investing account in March 2026. She had never bought a stock before. She puts in $150 each month. This summer, a dip in prices made her nervous, so she paused auto-invest. She wants to understand what her money is doing without feeling lost.
worries: Doing something wrong and not being able to undo it

devices.phone: iPhone, one hand, between other things

moments.P301: Sunday morning at her laptop, doing a calm weekly review of the whole account.
moments.P302: An evening on the couch, working through one lesson about why starting early matters.
moments.P303: A 60-second check on her phone between other things, like waiting in line for coffee: does anything need me, and why did my balance move?
